programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Manipulation : la voisine d'à côté
programme.desc: Un homme, impliqué dans une liaison avec la femme d'un banquier, se retrouve au cœur d'un scandale.

programme.title: Le Triangle Amoureux
programme.desc: Carl organise un week-end romantique de ski dans les Laurentides avec sa femme. Mais ce n'est pas la première fois qu'il se rend dans cette auberge : il y a passé de nombreux week-ends passionés avec son ex, Robyn, qui occupe toujours ses pensées...

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Mark a une vie de rêve : il est sur le point de devenir multimillionnaire et d'épouser son amour de jeunesse, Connie. Mais les choses ne sont parfaites qu'en surface : Mark découvre par hasard que Connie ne l'aime pas et compte juste voler sa fortune une fois le mariage prononcé.

programme.title: Permanent Midnight
programme.desc: Basé sur l'autobiographie acclamée du même nom, PERMANENT MIDNIGHT met en vedette Ben Stiller et Elizabeth Hurley dans cette histoire passionnante sur un écrivain de télévision chaud qui apprend de première main le côté sombre du succès à Hollywood.

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: Alors que Step (Clifton Collins Jr.) l'un des employés d'une usine d'essences alimentaires vient de subir un accident de travail, Joel (Jason Bateman) le propriétaire et son bras droit (J.K. Simmons) voient diminuer leurs chances de vendre la société à General Mills...

programme.title: Un Ete Magique
programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn, un célèbre romancier dont l'alcoolisme a sapé sa passion pour l'écriture, s'installe au bord du lac pour l'été dans. Sur place, il se lie d'amitié avec la famille voisine, une mère célibataire séduisante et ses filles, Cette famille va l'aider à retrouver l'inspiration.

programme.title: La liberté à tout prix
programme.desc: Allemagne de l'Est, 1984 : Frank Korbach se réjouit de fréquenter l'école d'art dramatique, tandis que son meilleur ami rebelle Thomas refuse de faire son service militaire. Avec l'aventureux mais naïf Alex, Thomas projette de faire une tentative désespérée de fuite vers l'Ouest. Sachant qu'il ne les reverra peut-être jamais, Frank accompagne Thomas et Alex à la frontière. Soudain, ils sont confrontés à une unité spéciale de la Stasi, la police secrète est-allemande. Bien que les garçons parviennent à éviter la capture, l'ancienne vie de Frank a disparu à jamais - il est maintenant devenu un fugitif. Le père de Frank, Kurt Korbach, est stupéfait par cette évasion. Kurt est un major de la Stasi, à l'insu de son fils. Convaincu que Frank est innocent, il persuade ses supérieurs que lui seul peut ramener son fils. Avec le suspect colonel Frey - une bombe à retardement prête à exploser - Kurt se met en route pour retrouver les garçons en fuite.

programme.title: Le roi du fleuve
programme.desc: Abel Grey est envoyé pour enquêter sur la mort d'un garçon d'une école locale huppée, retrouvé flottant dans la rivière.

programme.title: The Other Me
programme.desc: Un architecte est atteint d'une maladie oculaire qui l'introduit dans une réalité surréaliste dans laquelle il voit les motivations des gens. Les visions devenant intolérables, il tombe amoureux d'une femme mystérieuse.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: The New Captain Scarlet - Épisode 25: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: Le Convoi des Alliés
programme.desc: Le convoi pq-17 est le nom de code d'un convoi allié durant la seconde guerre mondiale. Les alliés cherchaient à ravitailler l'URSS qui combattait leur ennemi commun, le troisième reich. En 1942, le convoi pq-17 est attaqué par les allemands et entre tragiquement dans la légende : il perd 26 de ses 37 navires et seulement 11 marins survivent à cette catastrophe…

programme.title: Les Rolling Stones: Et La Fin de L'Idéalisme
programme.desc: À la fin des années 1960, l'Amérique a explosé. L'optimisme vibrant de l'été de l'amour a été brisé par des émeutes, des assassinats et une guerre sans fin. Capturant un esprit de défi juvénile, les Rolling Stones sont devenus la voix de cette nouvelle ère violente. Mais en 1969, il y a 50 ans, leur concert à Altamont a marqué la fin choquante de la décennie.

programme.title: The Road Within
programme.desc: Vincent, atteint du syndrome Gilles de la Tourette, fait la rencontre de Marie et Alex dans une clinique spécialisée. Ce trio atypique s'embarque dans le voyage de sa vie.

programme.title: Rien Que Pour Vos Cheveux
programme.desc: Agent d'élite du Mossad et véritable star dans son pays, Zohan (Adam Sandler) rêve de devenir coiffeur en Amérique. Profitant d'un combat contre son pire ennemi, connu sous le nom de Fantôme, Zohan se fait passer pour mort et s'envole pour New York armé uniquement de ses ciseaux et de son sèche-cheveux. Malgré son inexpérience, il est engagé par la patronne d'un salon de coiffure, une jolie Palestinienne. Alors que son passé d'agent semble loin derrière lui, Zohan est repéré par le Fantôme, qui compte bien en finir avec lui une bonne fois pour toutes...

programme.title: Dick
programme.desc: Alors qu'elles visitent la Maison Blanche, Betsy et Arlene, deux adolescentes, tombent par hasard sur une pièce recelant les secrets du Président Nixon. Pour découvrir ce qu'elles savent vraiment, « Richard le truqueur » les nomme promeneuses de chien officielles. Soudain les filles se retrouvent impliquées dans la fameuse intrigue politique du Watergate. Alors que le duo plonge dans l'aventure, même les hommes du Président ne pourront les empêcher de changer le cours de l'histoire.

programme.title: Un Ange Gardien Pour Tess
programme.desc: Doug, un agent des services secrets américains, est soulagé : il vient enfin de terminer sa mission au service de Tess Carlisle, la femme du précédent président des Etats-Unis.

programme.title: Coup de foudre et conséquences
programme.desc: Dans cette comédie romantique, Matthew Perry (Chandler de la série télé 'Friends') est Alex Whitman, un New-yorkais envoyé à Las Vegas pour superviser un projet de construction. Il y rencontre Isabel Fuentes (Salma Hayek, Desperado), et une attraction certaine les réunit le temps d'une nuit. Mais Alex ne revoit Isabel que trois mois après, quand elle lui apprend qu'elle est enceinte. Sur un coup de tête, il la demande en mariage. Mais Alex et Isabel découvrent très vite qu'un mariage ne se résume pas qu'à une chapelle à Las Vegas et un imitateur d'Elvis.

programme.title: Black/White
programme.desc: Theresa ramène son fiancé Simon Green à la maison, pour le 25e anniversaire de mariage de ses parents, mais elle a oublié de mentionner un détail : il est blanc. Bien déterminé à mettre fin aux fiançailles de sa fille, Percy Jones va prouver qu'un père n'a pas toujours raison.

programme.title: L'Attaque des fourmis géantes
programme.desc: Un groupe de rock has been veut tenter un comeback au festival de rock Coachella, dans le désert californien.Mais, à la nuit tombée, leur manque de respect pour la nature va se retourner contre eux et en faire la cible d'insectes surdimensionnés et affamés.

programme.title: Enchère et en os
programme.desc: La justice du 18ème siècle a finalement rattrapé son retard sur les pilleurs de tombes que sont Arthur Blake et Willie Grimes. La guillotine lui pendant au coup, le jeune Blake décide de se confier au Père Duffy..

programme.title: Deathgasm
programme.desc: Deux geeks chevelus s'ennuient ferme dans leur bled paumé et décident de créer leur propre groupe de metal. Mais une mystérieuse partition sur laquelle ils ont mis la main va briser cette relative quiétude : quelques notes jouées suffisent à déchainer les enfers sur leur petite ville.

programme.title: Votre programme reprendra rapidement
programme.desc: Nous nous refaisons une beauté ! Restez à l'écoute pour d'autres divertissements inestimables sélectionnés par Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Knucklehead
programme.desc: Walter Krunk est un orphelin de 35 ans qui vit dans un orphelinat depuis l'enfance. Il a une amitié avec un autre orphelin nommé Henry. Lors d'une pièce de théâtre à l'orphelinat, Walter ruine le décor en s'écrasant dessus lorsque son harnais tombe en panne.

programme.title: Les Impitoyables
programme.desc: Un prêtre et son frère jumeau se relaient pour défendre une petite ville contre le gang vicieux des Clayton.

programme.title: Le Géant de Métropolis
programme.desc: Muscleman Ohro se rend dans la capitale pécheresse de l'Atlantide pour réprimander son impiété et son orgueil, et s'engage dans la bataille contre son seigneur maléfique Yoh-tar et ses plans hideux de super-science.

programme.title: On continue à l'appeller Trinita
programme.desc: Bambino essaie d'apprendre à son frère Trinity comment devenir un hors-la-loi, mais ils finissent par sauver une famille de pionniers et à défaire un réseau de contrebande.

programme.title: L'ange et le mauvais garçon
programme.desc: Quirt Evans, un méchant tout court, est soigné et recherché par Penelope Worth, une jeune fille quaker. Il finit par devoir choisir entre son monde et celui dans lequel vit Pénélope.

programme.title: Terror Hospital
programme.desc: Un groupe d'étudiants décide de se faire peur le soir d'Halloween en allant visiter un hôpital psychiatrique désaffecté. Hélàs, l'esprit d'un patient, autrefois brûlé vif alors qu'il tentait de s'enfuir, hante les lieux. Le fantôme psychopathe veut par tous les moyens quitter les lieux pour de bon...

programme.title: The Witch In The Window
programme.desc: Lorsque Simon, père divorcé, amène son fils de douze ans, Finn, dans une région rurale du Vermont pour aider à remettre en état une ancienne ferme, ils rencontrent l'esprit malin de Lydia, l'ancienne propriétaire, décédée bien que n'ayant jamais quitté les lieux.

programme.title: Le Dernier Train De La Nuit
programme.desc: Deux jeunes filles, Carole et Lysa, rendent visite aux parents de l'une d'elles pour Noël. Dans le train de nuit qu'elles empruntent, elles sont agressées par deux hommes sadiques accompagnés d'une femme.

programme.title: Attaque De Requin
programme.desc: Alors que l'armée s'attend au pire un homme semble avoir la solution.Ce jeune étudiant parviendra t-il à sauver le monde ?

programme.title: Big Divorce
programme.desc: Fraîchement fiancé à Dylan, Michael se met en tête de retrouver son amour de jeunesse, Alex. La flamme renaît entre eux, et Michael envisage alors de rompre ses fiançailles.

programme.title: Box 27
programme.desc: Tom vit avec son père dans un conteneur, dans la pauvreté et le bonheur. Mais tout change lorsqu'un travailleur social de la protection de l'enfance intervient.

programme.title: Caged
programme.desc: Un homme est emprisonné et placé à l'isolement après avoir été reconnu coupable du meurtre de sa femme. En prison, il est hanté par ses propres démons et le fantôme de sa femme décédée.

programme.title: Swiss Army Man
programme.desc: Hank, un homme désespéré errant dans la nature, découvre un mystérieux cadavre. Ils vont tous les deux embarquer dans un voyage épique afin de retrouver leur foyer.

programme.title: Hector et la recherche du bonheur
programme.desc: Quand il réalise que ses patients sont heureux, Hector, un psychanalyste londonien entre en crise... Il se met alors à la recherche du bonheur en parcourant le globe.

programme.title: Au bout du tunnel
programme.desc: Un ingénieur en informatique paraplégique en fauteuil roulant entend des bruits et les voix de braqueurs de banques dans son sous-sol.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Deux frères retournent dans la secte qu'ils ont fui des années auparavant pour découvrir que les croyances du groupe sont peut-être plus saines qu'ils ne le pensaient autrefois.

programme.title: BA ACTION American Heist
programme.desc: Découvrez les bandes annonces des films à l'affiche sur les chaînes Box Office

programme.title: The Loft
programme.desc: Cinq hommes mariés se partagent secrètement un loft à New York pour assouvir tous leurs fantasmes. Mais la combine tourne au cauchemar quand ils découvrent le cadavre d'une femme inconnue.

programme.title: La Prophétie des ombres
programme.desc: Un reporter est attiré dans une petite ville de Virginie pour enquêter sur une série d'événements étranges, notamment des visions psychiques et l'apparence d'entités mystérieuses.

programme.title: La Fille qui en savait trop
programme.desc: Jeune Américaine en vacances à Rome, Nora Davis assiste impuissante à un meurtre. Personne ne croyant son témoignage, elle se met à accumuler les indices afin de prouver sa bonne foi. Petit à petit, ce jeu de piste la met sur la voie de la prochaine victime : elle-même…

programme.title: Mantra
programme.desc: Emma et Paul viennent de s'installer dans une banlieue pavillonnaire de province. À peine les cartons défaits, Paul doit aussitôt partir pour un long voyage d'affaires. Dans son bureau, Emma découvre un insecte perché dans un grand vivarium : une mante religieuse. Cette dernière la répugne autant qu'elle la fascine.

programme.title: Malum
programme.desc: Une jeune policière tente de percer le lien mystérieux entre la mort de son père et l'arrestation d'une secte. Pour ce faire, elle accepte de prendre poste dans le commissariat où son père a trouvé la mort. Bientôt, elle est victime d'événements surnaturels terrifiants...

programme.title: Creuse
programme.desc: Marc, un jeune citadin, part s'installer seul à la campagne. Il compte sur la venue prochaine de sa copine Louise, qui tarde à le rejoindre. Marc est obsédé par la routine « bien-être » qui rythme ses journées, mais le silence se fait de plus en plus pesant, et Louise n'arrive toujours pas. Dans ce calme angoissant, Marc se retrouve peu à peu assailli par des sons que l'on a l'habitude d'ignorer.

programme.title: Spit'n'Split
programme.desc: Une tournée de rock band, c'est des fans prêtes à tomber le tanga pour un autographe, des brouettes de coke et des pluies de billets. Les membres de ce groupe de rock aimeraient confirmer ce mythe. Sauf qu'eux, ce sont des longs trajets dans un van pourri, de l'aspirine et des bars vides.

programme.title: Vigilante
programme.desc: Fou de rage après l'agression de son épouse et le meurtre de son fils et écœuré par le laxisme et la corruption des autorités, qui ont permis aux responsables d'être libérés, un électricien new-yorkais s'acoquine avec un groupe d'auto-défense, dans lequel il refusait d'entrer jusqu'alors, afin de venger sa famille.

programme.title: Acceleration
programme.desc: Vladik Zorich, un seigneur du crime vicieux, est doublé par son agent le plus digne de confiance, Rhona. Par vengeance, Zorich kidnappe le fils de celle-ci.

programme.title: Dahmer
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vrai, Dahmer raconte l'histoire du serial-killer Jeffrey Dahmer.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: Quatre astronautes isolés à bord d'un vaisseau spatial vivent une intercession fantomatique après une tempête de météores, entraînant paranoïa, peur et mort.

programme.title: Black Water
programme.desc: Quand l'agent spécial Scott Wheeler se réveille, il est blessé et menotté à une chaise. Impossible pour lui de se rappeler qui sont ses geôliers ni comment il a atterri dans cette pièce.

programme.title: Breakdown
programme.desc: Alfie, tueur professionnel, est hanté par des visions sanglantes de son passé. Alors qu'il perd peu à peu le contrôle sur sa vie, il se retrouve forcé de défendre sa famille contre ses propres employeurs.

programme.title: La Tour Sombre
programme.desc: Désireux de se venger du mystérieux Homme en noir, le Pistolero Roland Deschain erre dans un monde ressemblant au Far West, à la recherche de la légendaire Tour Sombre, qu'il espère capable de sauver son monde qui se meurt. D'après la série de romans de Stephen King.

programme.title: Horreur Dans La Ville
programme.desc: Chuck Norris, six fois champion du monde de karaté, est à l'affiche de son premier film à suspense dans le rôle du shérif dur à cuire et adepte des combats de rue dans une petite ville du Texas, terrorisée par un tueur psychopathe. Norris doit essayer de stopper le meurtrier invincible, qui a été rendu pratiquement indestructible par une transformation génétique. Un groupe de jeunes chercheurs est responsable de la création du sérum et le chef de l'institut de recherche est déterminé à continuer les expérimentations génétiques qu'elles qu'en soient les conséquences. Norris dévoile toute son incroyable habileté au combat lorsqu'il met en déroute une douzaine de motards violents et les chasse du bar de routiers qui leur servait de repère. Il révèle également son côté humain et romantique lorsqu'il reprend sa liaison avec Alison Halman (Toni Kalem), une chercheuse de l'institut. Excitation, horreur et romance sont les maîtres mots de cette histoire qui oppose Norris au tueur.

programme.title: L'Enquete
programme.desc: Sous des dehors respectables, l'International Bank of Business and Credit est une multinationale de la finance spécialisée dans le blanchiment d'argent et le financement d'opérations illégales. Face à elle, Louis Salinger, agent d'Interpol, et Eleanor Whitman, district attorney adjoint de Manhattan, sont déterminés à mettre fin à ses activités illicites.

programme.title: L'Ouragan Vient De Navarone
programme.desc: Ce film, suite du film à succès de 1961 « Les canons de Navarone », relate l'histoire de dix résistants qui tentent, durant la Seconde Guerre Mondiale, de faire sauter un pont stratégique en Yougoslavie. Comme dans le premier film, l'un des rebelles est un traître: le chef du groupe, Mallory (Robert Shaw), connaît son identité, mais ne peut rien prouver avant qu'il soit presque trop tard.

programme.title: Sniper (1993)
programme.desc: Tom Berenger et Billy Zane s'arment jusqu'aux dents pour l'incroyable suspense et l'action survoltée de cette aventure de guérilla avec une puissance de feu explosive. Un tir. Une victime. Sans exception. C'est la seule règle cruelle et expéditive à laquelle le célèbre tireur d'élite des Marines Tom Beckett (Berenger) obéit. Avec un impressionnant dossier de 74 victimes, il se sent d'attaque pour sa dernière mission. Mais est-il prêt à souffrir? Pour lui servir de guetteur, le Pentagone désigne GS-9 Richard Miller (Zane), un tireur d'élite médaillé d'argent visant une promotion à Washington. Ensemble, le tireur aguerri et le fonctionnaire inexpérimenté doivent traquer et abattre le redoutable leader des rebelles et le caïd de la drogue colombien qui le finance. C'est une mission suicidaire dans la jungle d'Amérique Centrale où un homme tient sa vie entre ses mains, et la vit une balle à la fois.

programme.title: Gangster Playboy: La chute des Essex Boys
programme.desc: Ce drame inspiré de faits réels raconte l'ascension et la chute du tristement célèbre gang des Essex Boys.

programme.title: Hannah Mangold & Lucy Palm
programme.desc: L'inspecteur Hannah Mangold retourne dans son ancien bureau après un long séjour dans un service psychiatrique. Au début, Lucy Palm, la plus jeune enquêtrice du département, se méfie de l'ancien chef du département Mangold. Mais plus elle travaille avec Hannah, plus elle l'apprécie.

programme.title: War Zone
programme.desc: Dans la confusion qui suit une attaque à la bombe sur un convoi en Afghanistan, un soldat hollandais ouvre le feu sur un Afghan suspect, pour constater que ce meurtre déclenche une série d'événements dramatiques qui jetteront une ombre sur la vie de tous les survivants.

programme.title: Votre programme reprendra rapidement

programme.title: Contre-Pouvoirs
programme.desc: En pleines retombées de la marée noire causée par BP en 2010, un politicien idéaliste doit se remettre en question lorsqu'un scandale sexuel met fin à sa carrière.

programme.title: Bounty Killer
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes débarque dans une petite ville pour récupérer une récompense. Une jeune femme le recrute alors pour régler un problème local.

programme.title: Game Of Death
programme.desc: Un diplomate, victime d'une tentative d'assassinat, est transféré dans un hôpital. Mais ceux qui ont tenté de l'éliminer s'introduisent dans le bâtiment pour terminer la tache qui leur a été confiée… C'est sans compter sur la présence de Marcus Jones, qui a été affecté à la protection du diplomate.

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer

programme.title: Empire State
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie d'un braquage de fourgons blindés survenu à New York en 1982, et considéré, à l'époque, comme le plus important de toute l'histoire des États-Unis.

programme.title: Sword Master
programme.desc: Le troisième maître du manoir de l'épée, considéré comme le plus puissant épéiste du pays, s'est lassé de la violence qui règne dans le monde des arts martiaux. Fuyant les effusions de sang, il se fait passer pour mort et erre en marge de la société en menant la vie d'un vagabond.

programme.desc: Christmas For Three

programme.title: A Holiday Wish Come True
programme.desc: Two sisters' only wish is to spend the holidays as a family, forcing their divorced parents to work out their issues and find love again.

programme.title: Christmas Comes Home
programme.desc: A widowed Texas farmer invites his new love home to meet the family for Christmas, only to discover the joys of the season mask a much deeper yearning.

programme.title: The March Sisters At Christmas
programme.desc: To keep the family home from being sold, four sisters tackle home improvement. But their romantic entanglements soon become a distraction.

programme.desc: Nadia and Carlos tackle the crop that Royalburn is most famous for: barley, but they branch out with a bold experiment to grow five million sunflowers on the upper paddocks of the Crown Terrace.

programme.title: High Country Farm

programme.desc: Rhino horn is very expensive in the illegal market and the poachers know it. Kaziranga has the only concentrated population of the one horned Rhino in the world. And poachers are attracted to Kaziranga like ants are to sugar.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, at the easternmost tip of North America, the landscape is pristine, dramatic, and very sparsely populated. In summer, icebergs occasionally drift along the steep cliffs. When the "Titanic" collided with an iceberg and sank just 300 miles off the coast of Newfoundland in 1912, the last radio messages were picked up in a small wooden hut on the Avalon Peninsula. Today, most Newfoundlanders live on Avalon. There are particularly many seabirds here. In Witless Bay, the newborn puffins are ready for their first descent into the Atlantic. But some stray onto the coastal road, attracted by the lights of the hotels and restaurants. In doing so, they run the risk of being run over. A team of volunteers saves the lives of countless young birds: The Puffin & Petrel Patrol goes out at night dressed in high-visibility vests to collect the puffins. Biologist Sabrina Wilhelm then brings them back to Green Island, home to the largest puffin colony in North America. Here, the birds catch up on what they should have done long ago: the first dive of their lives.

programme.title: Berlin from Above
programme.desc: Unique pictures from above. This documentary shows a different angle of people and country, during a glide flight above the metropolis. More than 25 years after the reunion between East and West Germany, this movie shows pictures from different perspectives. Which visions and dreams marked this region? What changed and what emerged in Germany's tensed city. We take a look from above to see the city and its citizens. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to see how the people make this area their home. The movie unites nature, urbanity, tranquility and the rush of a metropolis. It unites parks and skyscraper canyons, lake capes and wetlands, curvy courses of rivers and straight streets. With exhilarating pictures we take a trip through Berlin- from sunrise til sunset. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to get a glimpse at how the people make this area their home.

programme.title: U-KNOW 'I-KNOW' Spoiler Film
programme.desc: Clues like word puzzles and coins, combined with the rhythm of “Body Language,” hint at the overall concept of the album.TVXQ! U-Know released a spy-style ‘I-KNOW' Spoiler Film to heighten anticipation for his upcoming comeback.

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Body Language' MV
programme.desc: TVXQ! U-Know kicks off his first full-length album ‘I-KNOW' promotions with the pre-release of the new track “Body Language.” The music video artistically portrays villagers coming together through dance, with choreography by Vata of WeDemBoyz and RIEHATA of RIEHATOKYO. “Body Language” is a dance track blending blues, funk, and retro hip-hop, delivering a message of unity through dance. TVXQ! U-Know's lively vocals and performance amplify the song's upbeat and cheerful energy.

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Set In Stone' MV
programme.desc: TVXQ's U-KNOW has completed his own musical world with his first full-length album, “I-KNOW.” The album opens with the intro track “Set In Stone,” an energetic pop song built around a powerful synthesizer riff. With its straightforward melody and strong rhythm, the track delivers Yunho's determination to “engrave the self I've preserved through doubt and confusion firmly in stone.”

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Stretch' MV
programme.desc: The title track “Stretch” is a pop song characterized by its powerful electronic sound, with murmured vocals that create a striking contrast and deliver a sense of tension. Furthermore, the “Stretch” music video captures U-KNOW facing his inner shadow and engaging in a tense confrontation, portrayed through cinematic visuals and intense performance. It is also narratively connected to the previously released “Body Language” music video, adding greater depth and dimension to the world of this album.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Mood Sampler #1 | Chapter 1. How2getHearts
programme.desc: Hearts2Hearts' first mood sampler for their debut mini album 'FOCUS' features a rulebook concept video that shows how the members "earn hearts." The group's vibrant visuals are paired with STELLA's captivating English narration.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Mood Sampler #2 | Chapter 2. Hard2Hide
programme.desc: Hearts2Hearts' second mood sampler for their debut mini album 'FOCUS' captures the members expressing the range of emotions experienced when falling in love, such as excitement, imagination, jealousy, sadness, and obsession.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Trailer
programme.desc: The album trailer captures the members' bold and free-spirited sides as they play around and dance together in a quiet space. In the latter part of the video, the title track “FOCUS” audio and part of the choreography are revealed, raising anticipation for the new release.Hearts2Hearts' first mini album FOCUS features a total of six tracks, including the title track “FOCUS,” the single “STYLE,” and the pre-release song “Pretty Please,” showcasing a diverse musical palette.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' MV
programme.desc: Its lyrics sensually express the feeling of being completely focused on someone, offering a fresh glimpse into Hearts2Hearts' unique appeal. Set against a school backdrop, the music video delicately captures the complex emotions between the members. Choreographed by Jo Na-In, the performance delivers a sleek and sophisticated atmosphere.Hearts2Hearts' first mini album title track “FOCUS” is a house genre-based song that features a vintage piano riff and an addictive melody, showcasing the group's cool and chic vocal charm.

programme.title: RIIZE 'Fame' Trailer
programme.desc: all captured through RIIZE's unique genre of “emotional pop.”Focusing on the unseen side of RIIZE's growth journey, the single features a total of three tracks, including the title track “Fame.” It expresses the members' moments of anxiety, emptiness, and the intense emotions that arise amid their struggles, RIIZE's new single “Fame” is set to be released.

programme.title: NCT DREAM : They Were Here To Beat It Up Trailer
programme.desc: The trailer “They Were Here To Beat It Up” wittily portrays NCT DREAM breaking through their limits and opening a new chapter of their own stage with surreal visuals and storytelling, powerfully setting the tone for the beginning of the new album.NCT DREAM's 6th mini album “Beat It Up” consists of six tracks, including the title track of the same name, “Beat It Up.” Centering on the theme of “the speed of time,” the album delivers a bold message that the members — who have been running toward their dreams since childhood — continue to grow, while confidently moving forward at their own pace and in their own way.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Getting Out the Vote
programme.desc: It's Stephanie vs. Tanya for Heartlake High Class President. But when Tanya resorts to dirty tricks, Stephanie decides to give her a taste of her own medicine. Elect Tanya as Heartlake High Class President?! "NOOOOOOOO!!!!" Not if Friends Stephanie, Emma, Olivia, Mia and Andrea can help it. The Friends are there to help their pal Matthew defeat Tanya -- even when Emma gets carried off by "Vote For Matthew" balloons! But Tanya figures since "Daddy" is now the Mayor of Heartlake City, she doesn't have to play by the rules. When she sneakily sabotages Matthew's campaign, it's time for a determined Stephanie to take his place as candidate. With the help of her friends, Stephanie is set on running a clean campaign -- that is, until Tanya resorts to more dirty tricks, and Stephanie decides to give Tanya a taste of her own medicine.

programme.title: The Grateful Dud
programme.desc: At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a teen bulldozer named Fiona. But when Fiona's pushy, over-the-top appreciation makes Mia's life a living nightmare, the Friends must Ride To The Rescue! At the Country Club where she teaches horseback riding after school, Mia's heroic rescue of a puppy and horse earns the overwhelming gratitude of their owner, a brassy teen bulldozer named Fiona. Although Fiona means well, her pushy, over-the-top appreciation soon makes Mia's life a living nightmare: embarrassing Mia at school, scaring away her boyfriend, and causing major havoc at the Country Club. The Friends must find a way for Mia to escape Fiona's nonstop gratitude and foil Tanya's sneaky schemes to get Mia kicked out of the club. And when a crisis erupts at the club's Fall Ball and Horse Show, all the Friends have to do some fancy riding to help their BFF save the day.

programme.title: Black Out
programme.desc: The power is out in all of Ninjag, but the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord has disappeared. Some mysterious Stranger has stolen it and is now sending alternatively powered Nindroids to attack the Ninja and capture Lloyd. After destroying the Power Station, the Ninja have dealt a massive blow to the Nindroids, but find getting back to the city troublesome without power. At the Junk Yard, Zane gives half of his heart to revive Pixal to help give guidance in their greater mission. Meanwhile, a mysterious cloaked Interloper steals the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord and creates a new foe for the Ninja to fight… Tech Wu. On the other side of Ninjago, Lloyd is trained by his father to harness his Golden Power to unlock an even greater potential – the power of the First Spinjtzu Master.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Golden Master
programme.desc: The Stranger and the hard drive with the Digital Overlord are still missing. The ninjas' search for them brings them deep underground where they are assisted by an old enemy. But the Stranger and his Nindroids are getting ever closer to capturing Lloyd. The Ninja return to a powerless New Ninjago City and visit the Serpentine Tombs in effort to solve who had taken the hard drive containing the Digital Overlord – only to discover the snakes have gone straight. They learn of Serpentine Lore that a Golden Master will conquer all of Ninjago. The Nindroids attack, but with the help from Scales and his Serpentine ilk, they fight off the enemy and discover the culprit they are after is none other than Pythor! But it's too late… the Digital Overlord and his henchman have captured Lloyd in a plot to sap his Golden Power to finally become flesh.

programme.title: Enter The Digiverse
programme.desc: Pythor the Anachondrai and his Nindroids have captured Lloyd and are draining his golden powers to bring the Overlord back into Ninjago. And the Ninja must use the Techno Blades in a daring rescue … inside the Overlord's corrupted hard drive. Unable to save Lloyd in time, the Ninja resort to drastic measures. With the help from Borg's advanced technology, the Ninja get digitized with their Techno Blades into the Digiverse in order to battle the Digital Overlord on his own turf and erase evil for good. While the Ninja learn new capabilities and explore the fantasy of a ‘digital world', their friends must protect them from Pythor and his army in the ‘real world'. In the climatic conclusion, the Ninja ‘reboot the system' and save Sensei Wu and Lloyd, but the Digital Overlord has managed to become flesh in the nick of time, only to be in a weakened state.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: When the Ninja receive an invitation to partake in the Tournament of Elements and a clue that Zane might be alive, they accept and travel to a Lost Island owned by notorious crime lord Master Chen in order to save their friend. The loss of Zane has fractured the team of Ninja, but when a mysterious invitation to Master Chen's ‘Tournament of Elements' arrives, everything is thrown into question – Is Zane alive, and are there others out there with powers like them? Sensei Garmadon warns them not to trust Master Chen, but they go in order to find Zane and make the team whole. On route to the island, the Ninja are briefly introduced to the other unique fighters with elemental powers, and the mysterious and beautiful Skylor intrigues Kai. Kai gets into a humbling scrap with Karlof, the Master of Metal, and learns some fights must be done on your own.

programme.title: The King's Tournament
programme.desc: Rival to the King, Jorah Tightwad thinks his knights – the Tighty Knighties – are easily better than the NEXO-Knights, so he challenges King Halbert to prove who's better during the King's Birthday Tournament. It's the King's birthday! To celebrate, the Queen and Macy always throw him a great, big birthday party consisting of a feast on birthday eve and a tournament the next day. At the birthday banquet is JORAH TIGHTWAD (last seen in episode 104.) He's goading the King (and on his birthday, even) and going on and on about how his knights are better than the NEXO-Knights. The King protests, but Jorah asks “How many magical books have your knights recovered? None, zilch, zero.” But he produces the BOOK OF ENVY, which his superior knights captured from Jestro. The next day, the NEXO-Knights square off against Tightwad's four knights: JOUSTING BEEBER, BRICKNEY SPEARS, SHIA LABLADE and THE BLOK. We see that all these knights are envious of the NEXO-Knights: their weapons, their fame, their hair, etc. Macy is also disappointed to find out she CAN'T fight in the tournament – she's agreed to be in “princess mode” for her father's birthday. During the tournament, we see that Tightwad's knights are amazing in fighting contests. They all pair-off with knights who have their same weapons skills. Tightwad makes fun of the NEXO-Knights as his knights do well. Jestro and the Book of Monsters discover that Tightwad has the Book of Envy and he and his monsters attack the tournament. Then we learn that Tightwad's knights might be good tournament fighters, but they can't handle real fights and the NEXO-Knights must save them! Macy is finally able to join in the fight when she sees Magmar show up on the flank. The NEXO-Knights successfully defend the king, but Jestro gets away with the Book of Envy. Tightwad must admit his knights never won the book from Jestro he got the book when Merlok blasted books of magic across the realm. Tightwad's knights all admit that they really admire the NEXO-Knights.

programme.title: Monster Chef
programme.desc: Axl and Chef Éclair must enter a cooking contest to try to keep Jestro from getting the hottest chili recipe in the realm. Knighton celebrity chef GOBBLETON RAMBLEY announces that he's developed the hottest chili recipe ever created. Now, he intends to give the recipe to the winner of his “Hottest Chili Cook-Off Competition” cooking show on Knighton TV. He'll turn over his famous Chili Cookbook with the hottest chili recipe on the last page. It's so unique it can't be recreated without it. Jestro and the Book of Monsters think they MUST have that recipe. “Hot chili makes hot monsters!” Merlok knows that this recipe, in the wrong hands – meaning Jestro's – could be dangerous. But when the Knights appeal to the egomaniacal chef, he says the only way to get the recipe is to win it from him. So Axl and Chef Éclair decide to enter. The team that creates the hottest chili will win Rambley's cookbook. Chef Éclair is unsure that Axl has the skills to help them win the competition, but, as we see through funny cooking show bits, Axl is quite good and they become a pretty good team. (We will also learn that years ago, Rambley stole one of Éclair's best recipes and they don't like each other.) While watching the multi-part competition, Aaron and Lance have a contest of their own: who can eat the hottest chili. Axl and Éclair actually win the competition, coming up with a raging hot chili recipe. Before they can claim their prize, Jestro and his monsters attack with Magmar leading the way on his siege tower. They must get that cookbook! During the battle, Rambley's cookbook is accidentally melted. After the battle, Rambley announces his new quest: to make the sweetest ice cream ever! While Axl and Éclair cook happily in the kitchen of the Fortrex, back in the Redoubt of Ruination, Jestro and Lavaria are attempting to recreate Rambley's chili recipe. They keep spooning various recipes of chili into the Book of Monsters. “Nope, not hot enough…waaaay too much garlic….you call that hot?!” (BELCH!)

programme.title: Knight Out
programme.desc: When the other NEXO-Knights decide they need a vacation from Clay, they send him on a holiday not knowing that he's going to a resort that houses an evil book or that Jestro will be heading there, too. Clay needs a vacation. Or, actually, the knights need a vacation from Clay! Clay is so super-focused that sometimes they just can't take it: training, training, maintenance, the Knights' Code tests then…more training. Even Merlok 2.0 is exhausted and he has no physical form! So, the Knights send Clay off on a holiday against his will (arranged by Lance because if there's one thing he can do it's plan a vacation.) But unbeknownst to the other Knights, Jestro and the Book of Monsters are tracking an evil book. A book that they suspect is located near the resort “Exalted Towers” renowned for its exquisite service, where Clay is staying. It's the BOOK OF CRUELTY and Clay notices that it's affecting the “high class” resort where Lance has booked him: the service is terrible, the staff is nasty, and everyone seems to take joy in being cruel to him (and to each other.) Meanwhile, the other Knights are having a terrible time because they realize that Clay takes charge of the basic maintenance of almost everything in the Fortrex. Stuff starts breaking down, chores are not getting done and everyone is getting on each other's nerves. Clay senses things are “off” at the resort, and discovers the book they've been using as the guest register is really the Book of Cruelty. As Clay scoops it up, he looks outside to see…Jestro and his monsters arrive on the Evilmobile. Clay battles as best he can on his own by setting traps and being cunning but he's finally caught. Just when it looks like this will be the cruelest vacation ever the other Knights arrive on their vehicles! They spring into action, free Clay, and battle and defeat Jestro and the monsters – though Jestro escapes. The Knights make Clay promise to never go on vacation again.

programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.desc: Uptight city accountant Michael Thompson is hired to help a family save their stable before the bank shuts them down. Michael reluctantly agrees, but as he searches for ways to save a family's legacy, he finds something he never expected.

programme.title: Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: A flying squirrel shows a youthful reindeer who suffers from vertigo how to soar into the sky. The reindeer heads to the North pole to save Santa and his reindeer.

programme.title: Braven

programme.title: Next Stop Murder
programme.desc: (2010) Dark crime drama starring Brigid Brannagh. A tense bus ride takes a sinister turn when a woman tries to lure a stranger into a deadly plan - and the clock is ticking.

programme.title: Wandering Eye
programme.desc: (2011) Dark thriller with Amanda Righetti. Neglected by her workaholic husband, a woman meets a man via a dating site for married people, only to put herself in a killer's line of sight...

programme.title: The People's Vet
programme.desc: Meet the dedicated teams of vets and nurses who provide the essential care and treatment needed by their furry patients at two of the UK's busiest Charity pet hospitals.

programme.title: Breaker! Breaker!
programme.desc: Truck driver searches for his brother, who has disappeared in a town run by a corrupt judge.

programme.title: Don't Say A Word
programme.desc: When Dr. Nathan Conrad's daughter is kidnapped, a secret held by one of his catatonic patients may be his only hope.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: It's a race for survival in the criminal underworld of New York in the action-packed thriller TRACERS.

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: While We're Young
programme.desc: Josh and Cornelia are a happily married middle aged couple, who seem content with where their life is going. One day whilst teaching, Josh meets Jamie and Darby, a free-spirited young couple, who are spontaneous and untethered. Before long, Josh and Cornelia throw aside their age to trail after the young hipsters and feel the zest for life they once had.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Three young women vacationing in Paris, find themselves whisked away to Monte Carlo after one of them is mistaken for a British heiress.

programme.title: Puppy Time
programme.desc: Get ready to fall in deep, deep puppy love as we follow a litter of adorable puppies as they play, nap, tumble, eat and play some more. Featuring the worlds cutest and most loved and treasured breeds including Pugs, Labradors, Dachshunds and Pekingese - these furry pups will have you laughing, crying, swooning and barking for more as we watch them discover their new world.

programme.title: All for Love
programme.desc: When an engaged romance novelist is teamed with a Navy man as research for her latest book, she is taken aback by his boisterous personality and egotistical nature. However, as her research brings them closer together, she discovers there's more to him than meets the eye. Will she choose the man she thought she loved or the real-life embodiment of her fictional hero?

programme.title: Traffic
programme.desc: A conservative judge is appointed by the President to spearhead America's escalating war against drugs, only to discover that his teenage daughter is an addict.

programme.title: London Heist
programme.desc: A bank heist goes bad and someone is murdered, but things may not be all they seem.

programme.title: Eaten By Lions
programme.desc: A hilarious and heart-warming story of half brothers Omar and Pete, who embark on a journey from Bradford to Blackpool to find Omar's real Dad.

programme.title: Foster
programme.desc: A heart-warming story of family and friendship starring Academy Award Nominee Toni Collette and Ioan Gruffudd.

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: The story of a young boy who witnesses Billy the Kid's encounter with Sheriff Pat Garrett.

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: A mother fights to defend her family from being massacred at the hands of a ruthless and violent gang.

programme.title: The Way of the Gun
programme.desc: Two criminals get more than they bargained for after kidnapping the surrogate mom of a powerful and shady man.

programme.title: Impact Earth
programme.desc: An astronomy professor makes the terrifying discovery that an asteroid is on a collision course with Earth.

programme.title: You Can't Fight Christmas
programme.desc: Interior decorator and Christmas fanatic, Leslie Major, has the yearly task of decorating the lobby of the famed Chesterton Hotel. But one fateful day whilst working on a ladder to reach the top of the tree, she falls into the arms of Edmund James, the grandson of the hotel's owner. However, Edmund is all business and plans to put an end to the annual tradition. Can Leslie work her magic and teach him to love Christmas?

programme.title: The Magic Reindeer: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Niko the Reindeer enjoys his cool and carefree life in the Arctic, but that all changes when he is given his most surprising Christmas present ever - a little stepbrother named Jonni! Niko is unhappy about this new addition to the family, but when Jonni is kidnapped by eagles, Niko realises that it's down to him to fly off and rescue his brother!

programme.title: My First Miracle
programme.desc: This is the story of Angelica, a 16 year-old girl who's battling a rare kind of cancer called Myelodysplastic Syndrome, her struggles to try to live a normal life, and her hopes of finding her first true love before it's too late.

programme.title: Christmas Ransom
programme.desc: In this festive comedy for the whole family, a pair of bumbling crooks break into a toy store on the verge of closing, and take the struggling owner hostage. Little do they know that two hideaway kids have also been locked in the store. With Christmas on the line, the kids team up with a heavily pregnant security officer in a series of hilarious and heartwarming escapades. Can they outwit the thieves and save both the store, and Christmas?

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina and Franklin are seemingly the perfect couple, but after five years of marriage, a huge fight at Thanksgiving leads them to divorce, set to be finalised on Christmas day. As they try to move on with their lives, will the festive spirit pull them back together? Starring Erica Ash (Scary Movie 5, Survivor's Remorse) and Eva Marcille (The Young and the Restless).

programme.title: Feedback
programme.desc: Starring Eddie Marsan (This is England), Paul Anderson (Peaky Blinders) and Ivana Baquero (Pans Labyrinth) and from the creators of Rec. Black Mirror meets Die Hard. Jarvis is a star journalist of a successful London late night radio show. One evening, two armed men burst in and take control. Their mission: to shed light on a scandal that could spell the end of Jarvis' established career.

programme.title: The Furies
programme.desc: FrightFest Presents. The Furies is Halloween meets The Hunger Games in this gripping & fast paced female-driven survival thriller. A young woman faces her darkest fears with seven other unwilling participants in a deadly game. A game that can only have one winner.

programme.title: Slumber
programme.desc: Maggie Q (Designated Survivor) stars in this mind-bending, sleep-paralysis horror. Sleep doctor Alice abandons all rational scientific reasoning while investigating a peculiar family case - a legendary demon that feeds on its victims by paralysing them in their sleep. To help this family from their nightmare, she must confront her own childhood demons to defeat this dark spirit. Truly eye-opening!

programme.title: Bigger
programme.desc: A rags-to-riches biopic of visionary Joe Weider, set in the world of fitness and starring Tyler Hoechlin (Supergirl), Julianne Hough (Dirty Grandpa), Aneurin Barnard (Dunkirk) and Kevin Durand (Wolverine). Brothers Joe & Ben Weider were the architects of muscle. Along the way they discovered Arnold Schwarzenegger, inspired female empowerment, championed diversity and started a worldwide movement.

programme.title: Triumph
programme.desc: Triumph is an uplifting story about overcoming ones disability. Based on a true story, this inspirational drama stars Academy Award nominee Terrence Howard (Crash), RJ Mitte (Breaking Bad) and Colton Haynes (Arrow). A determined teen who has mild cerebral palsy strives to be a wrestler on his high school's team and goes to humorous lengths to win over the heart of the girl of his dreams.

programme.title: Home For Harvest
programme.desc: (2019) Charming romance with Brigitte Kingsley. A writer is assigned to cover a story in the town she left, heartbroken, years ago - only to find herself torn between her ex and a new man in town...

programme.title: Autumn in The City

programme.title: Harvest Moon

programme.title: Becks

programme.title: Still Today
programme.desc: After being left at the altar, Pete's groomsman give him a wedding gift he'll never forget. An escort. Maybe it's the Lunar Eclipse, maybe it's fate, but after a magical night in the city maybe this girl is what Pete needed all along.

programme.title: Love's Second Chance

However, as the agent works with her client on a new cookbook, she must choose between following the directions or her heart.

programme.title: Christmas Together
programme.desc: A woman leaves New York for LA after a break-up and falls in love while renting the guest house of a young father.

programme.title: Christmas à la Carte
programme.desc: When food correspondent, CARLY, gets a shot at her own show nothing goes as planned. She's sent to Angel Heights to help GRANT, a chef, reopen her family's beloved diner and film it for her television show.

programme.desc: When Ashley's plans to reconnect with her high school sweetheart over Christmas fails, she and her best friend Liam decide to fake their own romance. But as her feelings start to turn real, Ashley will have to decide what her heart really wants.

Derek is incredibly protective about the format of Wakeup, Chicago while Layla is always looking to shake things up. One morning they discover an adorable baby named Poppy left in a basket in Laylas dressing room. The mother passed away and the caretaker is unable to care for Poppy and is convinced that Layla and Derek will make perfect parents.

programme.title: Finding Grace
programme.desc: A troubled teenage girl is forced to provide community service in a retirement home. As she develops a friendship with one of the residents and becomes closer to her father, she discovers the power of family, hope and faith.

He is only interested in making himself look better by appearing charitable. Ivy is happy when he goes on his way, but then an accident injures one of Dylan's trusted advisors, Blake. Dylan insists Ivy stay at Dylan's lavish estate in Bali to care for Blake until he's well.

programme.title: U-KNOW 'I-KNOW' Spoiler Film
programme.desc: Clues like word puzzles and coins, combined with the rhythm of “Body Language,” hint at the overall concept of the album.TVXQ! U-Know released a spy-style ‘I-KNOW' Spoiler Film to heighten anticipation for his upcoming comeback.

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Body Language' MV
programme.desc: TVXQ! U-Know kicks off his first full-length album ‘I-KNOW' promotions with the pre-release of the new track “Body Language.” The music video artistically portrays villagers coming together through dance, with choreography by Vata of WeDemBoyz and RIEHATA of RIEHATOKYO. “Body Language” is a dance track blending blues, funk, and retro hip-hop, delivering a message of unity through dance. TVXQ! U-Know's lively vocals and performance amplify the song's upbeat and cheerful energy.

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Set In Stone' MV
programme.desc: TVXQ's U-KNOW has completed his own musical world with his first full-length album, “I-KNOW.” The album opens with the intro track “Set In Stone,” an energetic pop song built around a powerful synthesizer riff. With its straightforward melody and strong rhythm, the track delivers Yunho's determination to “engrave the self I've preserved through doubt and confusion firmly in stone.”

programme.title: U-KNOW 'Stretch' MV
programme.desc: The title track “Stretch” is a pop song characterized by its powerful electronic sound, with murmured vocals that create a striking contrast and deliver a sense of tension. Furthermore, the “Stretch” music video captures U-KNOW facing his inner shadow and engaging in a tense confrontation, portrayed through cinematic visuals and intense performance. It is also narratively connected to the previously released “Body Language” music video, adding greater depth and dimension to the world of this album.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Mood Sampler #1 | Chapter 1. How2getHearts
programme.desc: Hearts2Hearts' first mood sampler for their debut mini album 'FOCUS' features a rulebook concept video that shows how the members "earn hearts." The group's vibrant visuals are paired with STELLA's captivating English narration.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Mood Sampler #2 | Chapter 2. Hard2Hide
programme.desc: Hearts2Hearts' second mood sampler for their debut mini album 'FOCUS' captures the members expressing the range of emotions experienced when falling in love, such as excitement, imagination, jealousy, sadness, and obsession.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' Trailer
programme.desc: The album trailer captures the members' bold and free-spirited sides as they play around and dance together in a quiet space. In the latter part of the video, the title track “FOCUS” audio and part of the choreography are revealed, raising anticipation for the new release.Hearts2Hearts' first mini album FOCUS features a total of six tracks, including the title track “FOCUS,” the single “STYLE,” and the pre-release song “Pretty Please,” showcasing a diverse musical palette.

programme.title: Hearts2Hearts 'FOCUS' MV
programme.desc: Its lyrics sensually express the feeling of being completely focused on someone, offering a fresh glimpse into Hearts2Hearts' unique appeal. Set against a school backdrop, the music video delicately captures the complex emotions between the members. Choreographed by Jo Na-In, the performance delivers a sleek and sophisticated atmosphere.Hearts2Hearts' first mini album title track “FOCUS” is a house genre-based song that features a vintage piano riff and an addictive melody, showcasing the group's cool and chic vocal charm.

programme.title: RIIZE 'Fame' Trailer
programme.desc: all captured through RIIZE's unique genre of “emotional pop.”Focusing on the unseen side of RIIZE's growth journey, the single features a total of three tracks, including the title track “Fame.” It expresses the members' moments of anxiety, emptiness, and the intense emotions that arise amid their struggles, RIIZE's new single “Fame” is set to be released.

programme.title: NCT DREAM : They Were Here To Beat It Up Trailer
programme.desc: The trailer “They Were Here To Beat It Up” wittily portrays NCT DREAM breaking through their limits and opening a new chapter of their own stage with surreal visuals and storytelling, powerfully setting the tone for the beginning of the new album.NCT DREAM's 6th mini album “Beat It Up” consists of six tracks, including the title track of the same name, “Beat It Up.” Centering on the theme of “the speed of time,” the album delivers a bold message that the members — who have been running toward their dreams since childhood — continue to grow, while confidently moving forward at their own pace and in their own way.

With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

programme.title: Har Har Bhakti
programme.desc: Listen to Har Har Bhakti Devotional songs and start your day with praise of gods and goddesses. These songs are composed to inspire reverence, devotion, and connection with the divine.

programme.title: Paapnaashini Ganga
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Do Chutki Sindoor
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu Monster Paln S1 Ep 44
programme.desc: The crazy scientist, Doctor Rex Vector, and his hamster assistant, Mister Pete, return to Pine Tree Mountain with Vector's new, evil invention: a robo-monster complete with animal abilities. But first, Vector needs to collect these skills. He comes up with a power absorbing gadget, which he often disguises, in order to trap and steal abilities from the innocent animals. Vick, Briar and Bramble, along with other animal friends, must stand up against this “monster plan” of Vector's. It's going to be a fierce fight between wild animals and poaching villains.

programme.title: Fury Spinner Ep 06 Part A
programme.desc: After decades of development, Fury Spinner duel has become one of the most popular sports in the world. At this time, the "Ultimate Feast" Invitational Tournament of Fury Spinner began. The protagonist Meteo is invited to the mysterious island together with other top players in the world to embark on a survival adventure. During the adventure, Meteo not only relied on his determination to protect the weak and gained recognition to unlock the power of the sacred beast, but also got acquainted with the hidden master Kim who came here to find his brother and Joll who wanted to prove as the “perfect warrior” to his father. However, this "Ultimate Feast" tournament is just a conspiracy of the organizer Kenji! He wants to use the players to awaken the evil forces in the island to destroy the world! Meteo and friends stepped forward and tried their best to defeat Kenji.

programme.title: Bablu Dablu Squad 2 Ep 31
programme.desc: Bablu Dablu Squad is a team of four: Bablu, Dablu, Lakha and Neva. They are the town's guardians, patrolling the forest and helping residents in need. Together, they overcome many challenges, interact with lots of different characters and help their friends break their bad habits.

programme.title: Sanrachna
programme.desc: Shelter - one of mankind's most basic physiological needs. At least that's what it started out as at the beginning of time. From dwelling in caves to carving out temples in mountains, mankind has redefined shelter with every passing era. Though the underlying philosophy of any monument is to serve some sort of function, great architecture is fuelled by imagination. India's architecture is built on that very imagination and is a fascinating fusion of both art and science. From strategically placed astronomy towers to impressive and awe-inspiring tombs, Indian architecture has pushed the limits of engineering and design. Sanrachna explores these architectural wonders and how the makers of these marvels made them without the aid of modern mechanics and machinery. With an immensely astute sense of engineering, the architects were able to construct fortresses that have stood the test of time, unshaken by its changes. Join our host Vaibhavi as she travels through the country discovering the fascinating stories behind India's outstanding monuments and its architecture. Sanrachna will leave you in awe of the past and its ability to do what we can't, even with our modern tools and fancy tricks.

programme.title: Ekaant
programme.desc: India is known for its remarkable architecture and serene landscapes. Its rich history is steeped in mystery its vastness - lends itself to several stories and urban legends. Ekaant takes you through the abandoned roads and alleys of some of India's historic locations. Travelling through the spread out palaces and deserted forts, the show documents and investigates the eerie processes of abandonment of each site. How flourishing towns and cities came to be in ruins, is the question each episode seeks to answer. Ekaant explores the ceasing of life and the triumph of nature even in the most populated of places and takes you on the road no longer travelled.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan
programme.desc: Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan is a culinary history show that explores the food of the royals and their erstwhile states. The show takes it's viewers through an amazing journey of anecdotes, folktales, architecture, art, history and landscape and delves into the unique customs and traditions of the various provinces. All these culminate into beautiful renditions of the recipes unique to those regions. This new season of Raja Rasoi aur Anya Kahaniyaan focuses on the royal families as protagonists and explores their personal stories and journeys that shaped their present day food practices.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Kahi Suni
programme.desc: In a land steeped in mysticism, spirituality, and religion, the imagination of the followers has much room to flourish. Stories abound – some based on truth and some only on fractions of the truth. Nevertheless, these stories have enchanted their listeners for eons. Kahi Suni packs away our skepticism and takes us on a ride through the legendary tales of India. Each destination covered in the episodes has been the birthplace of a legend and each legend has given rise to the recognition of that location. Following our host from north to south and east to west, we journey through the land of myths of legends uncovering the origins of evIery story.

programme.title: Bharat Ratna The Jewels Of India
programme.desc: Bharat Ratna The Jewels of India is a show that celebrates the recipients of India's highest civilian honour. Through the medium of graphics and information, the show, intends to exhibit hidden unknown and loved stories from lives of these legendary characters.

programme.title: The Great Escapes
programme.desc: Dive into a world of action, drama, determination and courage while reliving the greatest escape stories of our time in an all new mini-series ‘The Great Escape'.The show is based on true events and takes you on a thrilling ride of the most daring escapes from Indian history. Some of the stories covered in the series include Sushmita Banerjee's escape from the Taliban in Afghanistan, Dalai Lama's escape from Tibet, the story of a daring jailbreak by the inmates of a jail in Punjab, and Indian prisoner-of-war Nihal Singh and Ram Chander Yadav's escape from the clutches of the Chinese in the Indo-China war. The mini-series even has some comments from the people who made these exhilarating escapes, including the Dalai Lama himself. Each episode takes you to different locations across varied time periods. The stylizations of those eras, mixed with the thrill of escape keeps you hooked till the end.

programme.desc: Saschiz, village, and commune, Mureș județ county is located in central Romania. The villages of Saschiz, Mihai Viteazu, and Cloașterf make up the larger commune of Saschiz. Located in the old region of Transylvania, it lies about 20 km east of Sighișoara"&". First documented in the 14th century, Saschiz is known for its medieval fortress and church constructed by Transylvanian Saxons, a German speaker. They settled in Transylvania when it was part of Hungary. The ruins of the 14th-century fortress sit atop "&"a hill overlooking the village. The late 15th-century fortified church has Gothic details and an imposing clock tower. Along with five other villages with fortified churches, Saschiz was inscribed on UNESCO's World Heritage sites in 1999.
